**`mda_open(section_id)`** is the tool.

- It returns the exact source lines of a section. It re-hashes the section against the current file at read time (`design/mcp.md`, tool table; `project-plan.md` §5, tool table).
- If the file has changed since indexing, it returns the current lines with `stale: true`, plus the current `section_id` (`design/mcp.md`). It also enqueues the doc for re-indexing at top priority (`project-plan.md` §4.3, "Read-time freshness check").
